name: ExcelExporter
purpose: Creates Excel workbooks with optional streaming for large datasets.
api_signature: class ExcelExporter: create_workbook(...), add_sheet(...), stream_rows(...), to_bytes(...)
invariants: EXCEL_EXPORTER_INV_01: openpyxl is required: pip install openpyxl
EXCEL_EXPORTER_INV_02: Export exceeds EXCEL_MAX_ROWS={?}. Add filters to reduce the dataset.
